h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Uttarakhand & Himachal Pradesh

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Uttarakhand & Himachal Pradesh

items.pText: Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh share the Himalayan foothills, cold winters and a large visitor economy, but the sites we plan in each are quite different. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for boarding and day schools, hotels and resorts, cantonments, municipal parks and housing projects in both states.

In Uttarakhand, Dehradun is known for its old boarding schools and has growing residential areas. Haridwar and Rishikesh are pilgrimage towns on the Ganga with ashrams and riverside hotels, and Nainital and Mussoorie are hill stations full of hotels. In Himachal, Shimla, Manali and Dharamshala have hotels, resorts and schools on steep ground, and towns in the lower hills have more level sites. We make every piece at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, send it by road and install it with our team or a dealer in north India. Share your site size, the age group and photos, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

props.h3Text: Top Factors Which Play an Important Role in Making Us a Top-Level Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer in Uttarakhand & Himachal Pradesh?

items.pText: Our play equipment is made from safe and tested materials. They do not harm your children or the environment in any way. Besides, the royal finishing work and beautiful colors of our tools attract the kids. Our group of craftsmen creates every product after following environmental norms and all the best practices.

The deadline is everything for our team. We work immediately after receiving the order from the client. All our products are delivered within the specified time limits and without any quality compromise. We keep accuracy in every work and install playground equipment within the given deadline.

One reason that makes us an exceptional Outdoor Playground Equipment manufacturer in Uttarakhand & Himachal Pradesh is our work experience. We have been working in this field for over 15 years and gained a lot of exposure across the nation. With sound industry experience, our company has become the leading manufacturer of playground equipment. Apart from that, we have highly trained staff that makes creative products using their skills.

Low-grade equipment might look pretty but do not stay for long. It is because they contain cheap quality raw materials. We pick the top quality raw materials to make playground equipment. Once installed, our playground equipment can work for many years. Apart from that, they do not need regular maintenance, replacement of parts, or servicing. Your kids can enjoy playing with our superb quality equipment for many coming years.

Our professional workers make different kinds of equipment for the playground. We make products such as merry go round, spring tider, swing, toddler rocker, see-saw, and many others. Our playground equipment has amazing colors, shapes, and designs. In addition to that, the products manufactured by us give every physical exercise to your kids including jumping, running, and walking, and so on. We design the equipment according to the age of the children.

items.pText: Search for the leading Playground Equipment manufacturer in Uttarakhand & Himachal Pradesh on Google or any other search engine and you will see our company’s name in the first five results. You can also check the reviews provided by our existing customers to understand more about our products and services.

c: The plains and valley towns, such as Dehradun and Haridwar, have hot summers and a heavy monsoon, so plan drainage and shade. Higher towns such as Shimla and Manali get cold winters and snow, and the ground can freeze. There, install between spring and autumn so grouting sets well, clear snow off decks and check fittings after winter.

facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can a boarding school order a full playground in one go?
items.a: Yes. Send the ground plan and the age groups of your students. We suggest equipment for each group, show it on one layout drawing with the safe play areas marked, and install it after you approve.

items.q: Is it possible to install a playground on a hillside hotel property?
items.a: Yes, on a level terrace or a cut pad with drainage. Compact play towers fit small terraces. Fence any edge with a drop, and send photos so we can suggest the right base.
Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic are weather-proof. Clear heavy snow from decks and roofs, keep children off icy surfaces and check bolts and swing hangers when the snow melts.
